That commitment has driven us to evolve time and again, and today it enables us to reach more Puerto Ricans than ever before. This is the next edition of that story.

Driven by desperation, her unwavering faith culminates in a profound, life-altering encounter with God, an experience that shatters her old life and rebuilds her from the ground up. CHANGED FOREVER follows Alexis's arduous journey to sobriety, healing, and ultimately, redemption. More than just a story of overcoming addiction, CHANGED FOREVER is a testament to the transformative power of faith and prayer, offering a beacon of hope to anyone struggling to find their own new beginning.

As the road unwinds, together they overcome the obstacles that are thrust in their way both externally and internally by ghosts from his uncle’s dark past. With grim determination and humor these two men bond together forever marking young Collin as he finally steps into manhood.  Jeffrey’s Turn with its universal message of coming to terms with your past while learning to live in the present is both hopeful but realistic in its portrayal of living as a Mi’kmag man in today’s society
